name: PayFlow - cloud-agnostic microservices on Kubernetes
description: Payments microservices behind an API gateway with Kafka, Redis and PostgreSQL on Kubernetes; seeded security, performance, resilience and operability concerns in the manifests and architecture notes.

revision.title: Hardening revision 1
revision.change_notes: Gateway and orders service scaled to multiple replicas with probes and resource limits; images pinned; privileged mode and hostNetwork removed; literal credentials replaced with secret references; TLS added to the Ingress; default-deny NetworkPolicy added; dangling reporting route removed.
